title: Dre’ from Jerz Impresses With Latest Single “Garden State Freestyle, Pt. 1”
htmlContent:
Dre' from Jerz, the multifaceted hip-hop/rap recording artist, music producer and songwriter from New Jersey, has once again captivated audiences with his latest release, “Garden State Freestyle, Pt. 1”. Known for his magnetic style blending boom-bap rap with conscious themes, Dre' brings a distinct and offbeat flow that sets him apart from the crowd.

From the early stages of his life, Dre' displayed extraordinary creative prowess, signalling that music was his destined path. Originally dreaming of becoming a comic book artist for Marvel, fate steered him towards the world of rap, where he found inspiration in the likes of Kanye West, Jay-Z, Wu-Tang Clan and Eminem.

Dre' from Jerz's musical journey extends beyond mere beats and rhymes; it embodies a profound message of resilience and self-care. Despite facing mental health challenges, he courageously utilises his creativity and platform to inspire others to prioritise their mental wellbeing.

“Garden State Freestyle, Pt. 1” is a testament to Dre' from Jerz's love for his home state, New Jersey. Recorded and mixed by the artist himself, the track exudes a mellow and vibey East Coast rap vibe. Produced by the esteemed East Coast hip-hop producer NY Bangers, the single encapsulates Dre' from Jerz's desire to uplift the image of New Jersey.

Speaking about the inspiration behind the single, Dre' from Jerz shared, “Repping New Jersey, I am proud of my home state and home town, Montclair, New Jersey. I wanted to do something to help uplift the image of my home state. I wanted it to be short, sweet and simple.”

Dre' from Jerz continues to solidify his position as a rising star in the hip-hop scene. “Garden State Freestyle, Pt. 1” serves as a testament to his versatility and artistic range. “Garden State Freestyle, Pt. 1” is available to buy/stream now on all platforms: https://lnk.to/GardenStateFreestylePt1.
